metadata.question: Was the Antarctic ozone hole larger on October 7, 2021 than compared to its area on January 1, 2021?

- Dataset: COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_O3 (fallback to COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/L3_O3).
- Dates: 2021-01-01 and 2021-10-07 (fallback ±3 days).
- Location: Antarctic region, latitudes south of 60°S (rectangle [-180, -90] to [180, -60]).

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Use S5P QA: qa_value >= 0.5 to retain high-quality pixels. No separate cloud band required.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If collections empty after fallbacks: C1.
- If valid pixels after QA = 0: C2.
- If computed areas are null/NaN or out of range [0, regionArea]: C3.
- Otherwise compare ozone-hole areas (<220 DU) on the two dates to decide A/B.

const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const region = ee.Geometry.Rectangle({coords: [-180, -90, 180, -60], geodesic: false});
    const dateA = '2021-01-01';
    const dateB = '2021-10-07';
    const DU_THRESHOLD = 220; // Dobson Units
    const DU_PER_MOL_M2 = 2241.15; // 1 mol/m^2 ~ 2241.15 DU
    const scale = 5000; // meters, to avoid timeouts

    // Helpers
    const ev = (obj) =>
      new Promise((resolve, reject) => obj.evaluate((v, e) => (e ? reject(e) : resolve(v))));
    const fmt = (x, d = 2) => {
      if (x === null || x === undefined || isNaN(x)) return 'NaN';
      return Number(x).toFixed(d);
    };

    async function tryCollection(dateStr, dataset, windowDays) {
      const start = ee.Date(dateStr).advance(-windowDays, 'day');
      const end = ee.Date(dateStr).advance(windowDays + 1, 'day');
      const col = ee
        .ImageCollection(dataset)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filterBounds(region);
      const size = await ev(col.size());
      return { col, size, dataset, windowDays };
    }

    async function getDUComposite(dateStr) {
      // Attempt sequence: OFFL 0d -> NRTI 0d -> OFFL ±3d -> NRTI ±3d
      const attempts = [
        { dataset: 'COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_O3', w: 0 },
        { dataset: 'COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/L3_O3', w: 0 },
        { dataset: 'COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_O3', w: 3 },
        { dataset: 'COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/L3_O3', w: 3 },
      ];
      for (let a of attempts) {
        let info = await tryCollection(dateStr, a.dataset, a.w);
        if (info.size > 0) {
          // Map: mask by qa_value, convert to DU, keep only DU band
          const colMasked = info.col.map((img) => {
            const qa = img.select('qa_value');
            const mask = qa.gte(0.5);
            const du = img
              .select('O3_column_number_density')
              .multiply(DU_PER_MOL_M2)
              .rename('DU');
            return du.updateMask(mask);
          });
          const duImg = colMasked.median().clip(region);
          return { duImg, meta: { dataset: info.dataset, windowDays: a.w, colSize: info.size } };
        }
      }
      return { duImg: null, meta: { dataset: null, windowDays: null, colSize: 0 } };
    }

    async function summarizeDU(duImg, label) {
      // Total cell count for region at given scale
      const totalCount = await ev(
        ee.Image(1)
          .rename('one')
          .reduceRegion({
            reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
            geometry: region,
            scale: scale,
            maxPixels: 1e9,
          })
          .get('one')
      );

      // Valid pixel count (after QA/masking)
      const validCount = await ev(
        duImg
          .reduceRegion({
            reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
            geometry: region,
            scale: scale,
            maxPixels: 1e9,
          })
          .get('DU')
      );

      if (!validCount || validCount === 0) {
        return {
          label,
          validCount: 0,
          totalCount: totalCount || 0,
          validPct: 0,
          holeAreaKm2: null,
        };
      }

      // Ozone hole area (<220 DU)
      const holeMask = duImg.lt(DU_THRESHOLD);
      const holeAreaM2 = await ev(
        ee.Image.pixelArea()
          .updateMask(holeMask)
          .reduceRegion({
            reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
            geometry: region,
            scale: scale,
            maxPixels: 1e9,
          })
          .get('area')
      );
      const holeAreaKm2 = holeAreaM2 ? holeAreaM2 / 1e6 : null;

      const validPct = totalCount ? (validCount / totalCount) * 100.0 : 0;
      return { label, validCount, totalCount, validPct, holeAreaKm2 };
    }

    // Region area for validation
    const regionAreaM2 = await ev(
      ee.Image.pixelArea().reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
      }).get('area')
    );
    const regionAreaKm2 = regionAreaM2 ? regionAreaM2 / 1e6 : null;

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    const a = await getDUComposite(dateA);
    const b = await getDUComposite(dateB);

    if (!a.duImg || !b.duImg) {
      console.log(`Region area (60S-90S): ${fmt(regionAreaKm2, 0)} km^2`);
      if (!a.duImg) console.log(`Data ${dateA}: images: 0 (after fallbacks)`);
      if (!b.duImg) console.log(`Data ${dateB}: images: 0 (after fallbacks)`);
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing and stats
    const statsA = await summarizeDU(a.duImg, dateA);
    const statsB = await summarizeDU(b.duImg, dateB);

    // Checks for C2 (no valid pixels)
    if (statsA.validCount === 0 || statsB.validCount === 0) {
      console.log(`Region area (60S-90S): ${fmt(regionAreaKm2, 0)} km^2`);
      console.log(`${dateA} ${a.meta.dataset} w=${a.meta.windowDays}d, Images: ${a.meta.colSize}, Valid px: ${statsA.validCount}/${statsA.totalCount} (${fmt(statsA.validPct, 1)}%)`);
      console.log(`${dateB} ${b.meta.dataset} w=${b.meta.windowDays}d, Images: ${b.meta.colSize}, Valid px: ${statsB.validCount}/${statsB.totalCount} (${fmt(statsB.validPct, 1)}%)`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Calculation validation
    const invalidA =
      statsA.holeAreaKm2 === null ||
      isNaN(statsA.holeAreaKm2) ||
      statsA.holeAreaKm2 < 0 ||
      (regionAreaKm2 !== null && statsA.holeAreaKm2 > regionAreaKm2);
    const invalidB =
      statsB.holeAreaKm2 === null ||
      isNaN(statsB.holeAreaKm2) ||
      statsB.holeAreaKm2 < 0 ||
      (regionAreaKm2 !== null && statsB.holeAreaKm2 > regionAreaKm2);
    if (regionAreaKm2 === null || invalidA || invalidB) {
      console.log(`Region area (60S-90S): ${fmt(regionAreaKm2, 0)} km^2`);
      console.log(`${dateA} ${a.meta.dataset} w=${a.meta.windowDays}d, Images: ${a.meta.colSize}, Valid px: ${statsA.validCount}/${statsA.totalCount} (${fmt(statsA.validPct, 1)}%), Hole area: ${fmt(statsA.holeAreaKm2, 0)} km^2`);
      console.log(`${dateB} ${b.meta.dataset} w=${b.meta.windowDays}d, Images: ${b.meta.colSize}, Valid px: ${statsB.validCount}/${statsB.totalCount} (${fmt(statsB.validPct, 1)}%), Hole area: ${fmt(statsB.holeAreaKm2, 0)} km^2`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 5. Print concise evidence and final answer
    const pctA = (statsA.holeAreaKm2 / regionAreaKm2) * 100.0;
    const pctB = (statsB.holeAreaKm2 / regionAreaKm2) * 100.0;

    console.log(`Region area (60S-90S): ${fmt(regionAreaKm2, 0)} km^2`);
    console.log(`${dateA} ${a.meta.dataset} w=${a.meta.windowDays}d, Images: ${a.meta.colSize}, Valid px: ${statsA.validCount}/${statsA.totalCount} (${fmt(statsA.validPct, 1)}%)`);
    console.log(`Ozone hole (<${DU_THRESHOLD} DU): ${fmt(statsA.holeAreaKm2, 0)} km^2 (${fmt(pctA, 2)}% of region)`);
    console.log(`${dateB} ${b.meta.dataset} w=${b.meta.windowDays}d, Images: ${b.meta.colSize}, Valid px: ${statsB.validCount}/${statsB.totalCount} (${fmt(statsB.validPct, 1)}%)`);
    console.log(`Ozone hole (<${DU_THRESHOLD} DU): ${fmt(statsB.holeAreaKm2, 0)} km^2 (${fmt(pctB, 2)}% of region)`);

    // Final comparison
    const answer = statsB.holeAreaKm2 > statsA.holeAreaKm2 ? 'A' : 'B';
    console.log(answer);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error:', err);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
